verdict.rationale: Bulk export is a fair question for an LLM observability and evaluation platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents exporting traces or datasets to blob storage (e.g. S3/GCS) or to a data warehouse. Trace capture, dataset creation and MCP dataset management are ingestion and in-platform features, not export.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-export traces and datasets to blob storage or my data warehouse
